crud-endpoints.statement: The OpenAPI contract defines list and create on `/ruleLabels` and get, update and delete on `/ruleLabels/{ruleLabelId}`.

read-only-fields.statement: `lastModifiedTime`, `lastModifiedBy` and `createdBy` are documented read-only (ignored by PUT) in the Go SDK; `lastModifiedTime` is also documented as ignored by DELETE. `referencedRuleCount` is documented only as the number of rules that reference the label.

list-params.statement: The OpenAPI contract gives the label list two query parameters, `page` and `pageSize`; its text says the default page size is 100 and the maximum 1000 while the schema default is 250.

expect.name: pageSize
expect.description: Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

go-getall-paginates.statement: The Go SDK `GetAll` reads every page of `/zia/api/v1/ruleLabels` through the shared page reader.

go-name-lookup.statement: The Go SDK finds a label by name client-side: it lists every label and returns the first whose name equals the argument ignoring case, so a name lookup is case-insensitive and returns one label even if several match.

python-ruletype-endpoint.statement: The Python SDK has a method that calls `GET /zia/api/v1/ruleLabels/ruleType/{rule_type}`; the OpenAPI contract defines no such path and the Go SDK label package has no corresponding function.
python-ruletype-endpoint.conditions: Absence claim: the path keys of zia.openapi.json contain `/ruleLabels` and `/ruleLabels/{ruleLabelId}` only, and the Go file defines Get, GetRuleLabelByName, Create, Update, Delete and GetAll.

quotes: def get_rule_type_label(self, rule_type: str, query_params: Optional[dict] = None)

list-search-param.summary: The Python SDK documents a `search` parameter on the label list that the OpenAPI contract does not define.

positions.says: list_labels accepts a `search` query parameter for filtering results.

list-search-param.impact: Do not assume a server-side name search. Whether `search` filters by name, and whether the server honours it, is not shown; the Go SDK's own name lookup filters client-side.

rule-type-endpoint-backing.title: Whether the ruleType label endpoint is a stable REST surface
rule-type-endpoint-backing.detail: The call exists only in the Python SDK; the contract and the Go SDK have nothing for it. Unverified legacy statement: "It accepts as filter values URL_FILTERING, FIREWALL, CASB_DLP, CLOUD_APP_CONTROL, DATA_PROTECTION, GENAI, INDUSTRY_PEER, NEWS_FEED, RISK_SCORE, SANDBOX" (attributed to the Python docstring). The pinned docstring says only "The type of rule to retrieve labels for." and the example passes 'URL_FILTERING'; the rest of the enum is in no registered source. Call the endpoint against a scratch tenant to settle it.
